name: orc_whr_refprop_cost
title: Waste-heat-recovery ORC with a scroll expander, REFPROP mixtures and an equipment cost model
summary: Complete ORC recovering heat from an exhaust-gas/thermal-oil stream: three-zone plate evaporator and condenser with Thonon/Kuo/Hsieh correlations, scroll expander with fixed volume ratio, pump, pipe sizing and total equipment/investment cost; refrigerant properties as CoolProp calls on the mixture R245fa+R134a (the source uses the EES REFPROP interface; stored run: pure R245fa).

verification.summary: Compared with the EES stored solution, 356 common variables; about 90 are affected by corrections of two errors of the original (A_cd 10.96 vs 5.459 m²), the rest differ by a few % (property backend). A scratch run restoring the two errors gives eta_cycle 6.942 % (EES 6.964 %).
verification.reference: EES stored solution of the source file (386 variables): 356 common variables; about 90 are affected by the corrections of kuo and Hsieh_new (condenser, evaporator area, costs and cycle outputs downstream); the others differ by a few % at most, apart from the air enthalpy reference offset (see README)
verification.notes: max_rel_diff excludes the ~90 outputs affected by the corrections (listed in the README). Maximum of the others: 0.252 = absolute air enthalpies h_a_ex_liq (reference-state offset EES ideal gas vs CoolProp Air); excluding that pair, 0.061 on Cp_r_ex_vap_cd (property backend). P_evap (26.18 bar in both files) is not counted: --ees-units scales its bar value by 1e5 (comparison tool artefact). Corrected values (re-baselined 2026-10-13 after the CoolSolve fix of CS-BUG-PI-FUNCTION, g# read as 1 in function bodies): A_cd 10.96 m2 (EES 5.46), W_dot_net 3213 W (3425), eta_cycle 6.50 % (6.96 %), SIC 3653 EUR/kW (2700); a scratch run with the original's two errors restored gives A_cd 5.53 m2, eta_cycle 6.94 %, SIC 2708 EUR/kW (0.3 % from EES). Native file not runnable (CS-GAP-END-PROCEDURE; then the undefined local string fluidev$ of hx_cd). The comparison was made with the earlier pure-R245fa transcription, whose solution the native file reproduces in all 362 variables (CoolSolve 0.3.0@4798e2b).
